Entries.UsedFor: accounts.json fixture — shape of the GET /accounts response used for tenant accountId auto-discovery (root-level array of account objects, PK field Id).
Entries.Excerpt: GET /accounts returns the list of accounts accessible to the token; each account carries Id, Name, PrimaryDomainName, Url. All names/domains scrubbed.

Entries.UsedFor: contacts-async-start.json / contacts-async-complete.json fixtures — the async Contacts list flow (kickoff returns ResultId + State; poll returns State=Complete + Contacts array).
Entries.Excerpt: The Contacts list defaults to async: the request returns a ResultId; poll ?resultId=<id> until State=Complete, then read the Contacts array. All contact names/emails PII-scrubbed to example+N@example.com / <scrubbed-name-N>.

Entries.UsedFor: events-page.json fixture — shape of a wrapped-collection ($top/$skip Offset) list response used to exercise NormalizeResponse envelope-unwrap + pagination.
Entries.Excerpt: GET /accounts/{accountId}/events returns an Events-wrapped array; each event carries Id, Name, StartDate, EndDate. Event names/locations scrubbed.
